items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Well anyway, we, I worked there all about a year with Tommy Brooks

ctx.x: Now you can make a little high ball, because I never did like it straight, because whiskey always was strong in my throat, you know? I'd get a little something, you know, Coke or 7-Up and make, but I have a fifth too. Now you didn't have to do nothing. When you get at 11 o'clock at night, that was your free. You just throw your finger up. And Cesar Thompson from your bandstand, the big ballroom here and your big long horseshoe ball over there, he'd look up there about that time, he'd look at his time up over the…
Yeah, see. In the 30's, you see.
